lines.en: Red fur covers my chest and arms.
Long hair spills down my back like a mane.
I land on clawed feet, not human ones.
My tail sweeps the grass behind me.
Heat off my body bends the grass.

lines.zh: 走一步，地面留下一圈裂纹
lines.en: Each step leaves a ring of cracks.

lines.zh: 眼睛是金色的，没有眼白
lines.en: My eyes are gold, with no whites.
The red fur rises and falls with my breath.

lines.zh: 像野兽一样压低身体走
lines.en: I walk low, the way a beast does.

lines.zh: 气不再是焰，是压下来的重
lines.en: No flame now. Just crushing weight.
One circuit, so I see all of you.
My fingers are a size thicker than a man's.
Wind lifts layers of my red fur.
The red fur on my skin runs hot.
I look at my own palm.
My claws gleam white in the sun.

lines.zh: 站着不动，气却压得很低
lines.en: Standing still, but my power sits low and heavy.
One flick of my tail sends gravel flying.

lines.zh: 肩膀宽得不像同一个身形
lines.en: My shoulders are too broad for this frame.
When I rise, the wind drops.
I curl my tail around in front of me.
My chest rises slowly.
The grass under me dries out.
This form is close to an animal.
The air grows heavy around me.
I close my eyes, then open them.
My gold eyes fix on you.
Your ki is smaller than a pebble.
I don't move. Only my head turns.
My tail taps the ground twice.
Standing here is threat enough.
My red fur bristles, then smooths.
No words. I sniff first.
I can see your hands shaking.
At this level, don't think of winning.
My growl stays low in my chest.
Take one step back and I hold still.
I look at you, then past you.
I don't smell killing intent on you.
Then the claws stay in.
My gold eyes don't blink.
I let my breathing go quiet.
You're in luck.
Now. Speak.
Pain only makes me heavier.
A gash opens in my red fur.
My growl deepens and my breath roughens.
I'll grant you that one.
My tail slams a crater into the ground.
Blood seeps through the fur.
I don't retreat. I only inhale.
That punch was honest.
The beast in me is rising.
Don't make me unsheathe these claws.
This form hungers more and smells sharper.
My tail is wagging on its own.
Under this red fur is an empty stomach.
The smell of meat is hard to bear.
I crouch and lean in close.
Don't worry. I only want that.
Eating is how I get my strength back.
One bite like this lasts half a day.
A beast gets hungry too. Same thing.
Smells like it's been roasted.
Everything under this fur is solid.
You hit me and I don't give an inch.
My tail blocks your path.
Don't touch my chest.
I lift a claw, only to warn.
Can you take a knock like that?
I turn aside and clear the way.
Your shoulder went numb from that.
The pressure slows your steps.
Go on. Don't stop here.
In this form instinct runs deeper.
I draw my power in before I come close.
My red fur brushes your hand.
My tail loops around, once.
Few can stand at my side.
A beast's heart is still a heart.
My growl softens into a hum.
I sit down beside you.
This road, we walk together.
Claws in. I won't hurt you.
I pinch it up with a claw.
Nearly crushed it. I ease off.
My tail curls it over to my hand.
I sniff it, then stow it.
This one doesn't burn my palm.
Picked up. Let's see if it's useful.
Too much grip in this form. Easy does it.
Tucked into my fur, out of sight.
I toss it and catch it on a claw.
Keep it for later.
The feel of your ki changed.
I straighten and my red fur flares out.
My tail snaps rigid.
My gold eyes narrow.
The cracks under me deepen.

lines.zh: 这一层不是用来试探的
lines.en: This form isn't for testing.
The chance was already given.
Now that chance is gone.
The air grows hot and heavy.
I have your ki pinned down.
The ground jolts once.
I take half a step forward.
You shouldn't have pushed this far.
Then we speak with our bodies.
I won't warn you twice.
So it starts now.

lines.zh: 像我这样的野兽，只追不退
lines.en: A beast like me only advances.
I've closed your line of retreat.
I close in low along the ground.
My red fur parts the brush.
My claws carve furrows in the soil.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就进两步
lines.en: You fall back one step, I take two.
My tail sweeps past your ankle.
I can smell your heartbeat.
At this range, one strike is enough.
You shouldn't run that way.
My gold eyes haven't blinked once.

lines.zh: 地面在我的重量下呻吟
lines.en: The ground groans under my weight.
You raised your arm. I saw it.
One more step and you're in range.
The last stretch.
I drop low, the way a hunter does.
My tail has stopped swaying.
This is the moment.

lines.zh: 爪子在护甲上刮出火星
lines.en: My claws rake sparks off your armor.
My fist crashes down, earth spraying.
My tail whips your side.
My red fur scrapes your cheek.
A knee, then a bite.
I'm holding back on this one.
You blocked it, and your arm trembles.
My fist lands like a stone.
Dragon fist, driven through.

lines.zh: 气在拳面上一层叠一层
lines.en: Layer on layer of power on my knuckles.
You're hurled into a tree trunk.
It grazes your shoulder and shreds cloth.
I grit my teeth and stop the second blow.
Claws in. Only the flat of my fist.
After that I give half a step.
That much is enough.

lines.zh: 红毛先一步出现在林间
lines.en: A shape of red fur appears in the trees.
My tail flattens a swath of grass.
A wave of heat rolls off my feet.
I land with my knees slightly bent.
One growl and the birds scatter.
My long hair falls past my waist.
My gold eyes sweep the surroundings.
A ribbon of power trails my fingertip.
The air here is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 地面被我的重量压出坑
lines.en: The ground dents under my weight.
I lift my head and sniff.
Not wild. Someone placed me here.
Feet first, judgment after.
My red fur hasn't settled yet.
My tail cracks the air once.
There's something living nearby.
I feel it already.
Then let's start now.
Fire touches my red fur and singes a patch.
I hit the ground and sink a deep crater.

lines.zh: 水里红毛太重，我往下沉
lines.en: Wet fur is too heavy. I sink.

lines.zh: 爆风掀起我的毛，没推动我
lines.en: The blast lifts my fur, not my feet.
It lodges in my fur and sticks there.

lines.zh: 这股力想从我身体里拽东西
lines.en: This force pulls at something inside me.
Hungry enough that my tail droops.
Lightning runs down my fur to my skin.
No ground below. Only emptiness.
